title: Lipschitz approximations of a varifold with small tilt are almost harmonic (Simon 4.5, steps (5)-(16))
statement: For n >= 1, l and K_b >= 0 there is C > 0 (depending only on n, l, K_b) such that: let U be open, V have generalized mean curvature H in U, x |-> p_x = V.tangentProj x be mu-a.e. strongly measurable, sigma > 0 with B_sigma(0) in U, q a linear isometry, T := rotatedPlane q, f : R^n -> R^l 1-Lipschitz on B^n_{sigma/2}(0) with |f| <= sigma/16 there, dist(x, T) <= sigma/16 for x in spt V cap B_sigma(0), and suppose that for mu-a.e. x, whenever x = q(graphPoint(x', f(x'))) with |x'| < sigma/2 and f is differentiable at x', p_x is the orthogonal projection onto span{q(graphPoint(v, Df(x') v))}. Let kappa in [0,1], E >= 0, h >= 0 satisfy: 1 <= theta <= 1 + kappa mu-a.e. on B_sigma(0); H^n((spt V cap B_sigma(0)) \ M_V) = 0 (M_V := V.carrier); int_{B_sigma(0)} |p_x - p_T|^2 dmu <= E sigma^n; mu(B_{sigma/2}(0) cap (spt V \ Gamma)) + H^n(B_{sigma/2}(0) cap (Gamma \ spt V)) <= K_b E sigma^n with Gamma := q(graphOver f (B^n_{sigma/2}(0))); int_{B_{sigma/2}(0)} |H| dmu <= h sigma^{n-1}. Then int_{B°^n_{3 sigma/8}(0)} |Df|^2 <= C E sigma^n, and for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R with tsupport in B°^n_{sigma/4}(0), every M >= sup |grad zeta| and every j: |int_{B°^n_{sigma/4}(0)} grad f^j . grad zeta| <= C (E + h + kappa sqrt(E)) M sigma^n.
